pieces.Text: As a move action, you may study a foe that you can see and make a Knowledge check appropriate to the creature's type (DC10+HD). Success grants you a bonus against your enemy based on your stance for
minutes or until you use the ability on another target. You may change your stance as a move action.
As a swift action, you may study a foe that you can see and make a Knowledge check appropriate to the creature's type (DC10+HD). Success grants you a bonus against your enemy based on your stance for
minutes or until you use the ability on another target. You may change your stance as a swift action.
